description: Creates a one-time upload link for an inventory item's photo or the company logo, valid for 15 minutes and for one upload. Best for full-size photos. Two ways to use it: (1) if you can run code and your sandbox can reach this server, POST the image file to the link as multipart/form-data with the field name "file" (for example: requests.post(link, files={"file": open(path, "rb")})); the response is JSON saying whether it worked. (2) Otherwise give the link to the user: opening it on a phone shows a page to take or choose a photo. If a POST fails with a network or proxy error, your sandbox is blocked from this domain, so fall back to giving the user the link (or to set_image_from_base64).

inventoryItemId.description: The inventory item id when target is "item" (from get_inventory).

target.description: "item" to set an inventory item's photo (also pass inventoryItemId), or "logo" to set the company logo.

name: get_image_upload_link
